sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sandeep Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Misra,J.
Hon'ble Jayant Banerji,J.

Sri Sandeep Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioner, fairly states that remedy of an appeal against the impugned order is there under Section 72 of the Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006 and therefore he may be permitted to withdraw this petition with liberty to take recourse of the remedy available under the aforesaid Act.
In view of the above, the petition is dismissed with liberty as prayed for.

Order Date :- 9.8.2021 Sunil Kr Tiwari  Mohd. Asif vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 August, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139993950/
